description: Dependency updates, adapted from the Canopi app's renovate.json (read at 0c425fb07), trimmed to Cargo and GitHub Actions. Weekly, grouped minor and patch per ecosystem; each major its own PR; exact pins wait on the dashboard; security updates at once. Inert until the Renovate GitHub app is installed on opencanopi/canopi-climate (owner action).

customManagers.description: The wasm-bindgen CLI that CI installs (`tool: wasm-bindgen-cli@x.y.z`) must equal the wasm-bindgen crate pinned in Cargo.toml; grouped with it below.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch, one group per ecosystem.
Minor and patch, one group per ecosystem.

Exact pins (Cargo =x.y.z: tiff, proj4rs, wasm-bindgen) wait on the dependency dashboard until the owner ticks them, each its own PR, since one pin in a group would hold the whole group; vulnerabilityAlerts still opens security updates at once.
The wasm-bindgen crate and its CLI move together: wasm-bindgen refuses a CLI of another version.
The Rust toolchain moves by hand with rust-toolchain.toml.

Matched by dependency name, since a git dependency's package name is its URL. The whitebox crates (wbgeotiff, wbhdf, the whitebox-wasm repository) come from one revision and move only with the code that measures them: moving one alone would split the revisions.
